user.title: PhotoPrism Library
user.description: Adds your photo folder to the media browser. HEIC photos are converted to JPEG on the fly, and two extra folders show photos from this day in earlier years and a random selection.

data_description.folder: Folder as seen by Home Assistant, e.g. PhotoPrism's originals mounted at /media/photos.
data_description.extra_folders: Optional, comma separated. Needed when files in the photo folder are symlinks pointing elsewhere (only these folders are ever served).

error.folder_not_found: Folder not found inside Home Assistant.

data.skip_screenshots: Leave PNG/GIF (screenshots, animations) out of On this day and Random
data.album_view: Dashboard view for albums as a grid

data_description.allow_delete: Every logged-in user gets a delete button on photo previews, the viewer, the grid and the slideshow card. Deleting removes the photo's files from disk (Home Assistant needs write access to the photo folders) and cannot be undone.
data_description.photoprism: Remove the photo from PhotoPrism too, before the files are deleted.
data_description.photoprism_url: Only for the app password option, e.g. http://photoprism:2342
data_description.photoprism_token: Only for the app password option. Create one in PhotoPrism: Settings → Account → Apps and Devices. Leave empty to keep the saved one.
data_description.similarity_url: Optional. The service from this repository's similarity folder, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8765. Empty turns the similar-photo button off.
data_description.similarity_token: Only if the service was started with a TOKEN. Leave empty to keep the saved one.
data_description.similar_view: Path of the dashboard view with a photoprism-library-grid card (source: similar), e.g. /photos/similar. The 🔍 button opens it with the photo.
data_description.album_view: Path of the dashboard view with a photoprism-library-grid card (source: folder), e.g. /photos/album. The grid button on the slideshow and viewer cards opens their album there, to select and delete several photos.

error.photoprism_app_password_missing: Enter the PhotoPrism URL and an app password.

photoprism_app_password_needed.title: Deleting no longer removes photos from PhotoPrism
photoprism_app_password_needed.description:
Photo deletion used the PhotoPrism integration's login, which this integration no longer reads. Until you give it its own access, deleting a photo removes only its files and PhotoPrism keeps the photo until its next index or cleanup.

To fix it, create an app password in PhotoPrism (Settings → Account → Apps and Devices), then open this integration's options, choose "Yes, with an app password" and enter the PhotoPrism URL and the app password. If deleting files only is what you want, ignore this message.
